$comment: Cases for src/content/format.ts. Each case calls `fn` with `args` and expects `expected`.

cases.name: a date-only string is the same day everywhere
the first of the month does not slip back a day
a full timestamp is read in UTC
no authors
one author
two authors
three authors
past three, the rest become et al.
max 0 shows everyone
a custom maximum
a need with its lead
args: Need for hourly smoke forecasts among emergency managers: forecasts arrive too late. Recommend an hourly product.

expected.lead: Need for hourly smoke forecasts among emergency managers:
expected.rest: forecasts arrive too late. Recommend an hourly product.

cases.name: "Need to" opens a lead too

expected.lead: Need to share data across agencies.

cases.name: no lead when the entry doesn't open with the phrase
no lead when it would swallow most of a paragraph

expected.rest: Need for a much better and more reliable way for every single emergency manager in every county across the whole western region to see smoke: details follow.

cases.name: a DOI link
www. and a trailing slash are dropped
something that isn't a URL comes back unchanged
something that isn't a date comes back unchanged
a relative date isn't a date
an impossible month isn't a date
a time written without a zone is read in UTC
a line break inside the lead means no lead
an older DOI keeps its characters as written
the host is lowercased, and a port and query are dropped
February 30 isn't rolled over into March
month 00 isn't a date
second 60 isn't a time
February 29 in a leap year is a date
an IPv6 host keeps its brackets
a password with an @ in it isn't the host
